name: Umbral-Sanctum
description: Silence has shape here: boulder fields, shattered scarps, knife-edge shadows, and far to the south, dust seas stretching to the horizon. Nothing wears any of it smooth.
No wind, no voice, no weather: the landscape communicates in light and shadow alone, and it has plenty to say at sunrise.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
There is money in titanium here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
